source.description: A levitating humanoid cluster of translucent ice crystals with a glowing pale-blue core, shards slowly orbiting the body, snow particles drifting, the core pulsing gently. Seamless loop.

The crystalline ice elemental with the glowing blue core attacks — its orbiting shards gather and sharpen, then fire forward toward the camera in a burst of ice splinters, then new shards reform around its body.

_notes: 1-direction object, side-scroller view. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
